label: MORNING BRIEF

stories.title: Heavy rain until December
stories.story: Government warns of heavier-than-usual rain through December, with El Niño possibly lasting to February 2027. People on flood plains are told to move.
stories.you: Buyers will ask about floods. Show plots on higher ground, and be honest about drainage.

stories.title: Idle investor land taken back
stories.story: UIA told MPs it has sent withdrawal notices to investors who left their land idle. MPs said 89 square miles from districts is surveyed but untitled.
stories.you: Plot near an industrial park? Ask for a title, not just a letter, before your client pays.
stories.source: Source: Parliament, via Uganda Online · 13 Nov 2026

stories.title: Mall plan for school land
stories.story: Government is weighing a plan to turn a 6–8 acre school site into a mall and arcade. KCCA objects, saying it holds a 99-year lease on the land.
stories.you: Big projects stall when ownership is disputed. Don’t sell on rumours of a mall coming.

stories.title: Mityana shuts dirty buildings
stories.story: Mityana Municipality has closed several buildings over poor sanitation. They stay shut until owners fix what inspectors found.
stories.you: Before you list, check the toilets and drainage. A closed building loses its tenants.

stories.title: Traders clash with URA over tax
stories.story: KACITA says taxes are crushing traders. Its 10 Nov meeting with URA’s Commissioner General failed, and it says police raided its offices on 11 Nov.
stories.you: Shop tenants are under pressure. Expect rent talks, and put any relief in writing.
